images.prompt: A small weathered stone watermill beside a narrow clear stream dropping over one short stone ledge, with a brown wooden wheel and grassy banks, no people or signage. Photorealistic camera photograph of a fictional independently generated scene. Vertical 4:5, 1024x1280 or larger. Natural material and light. No artwork, text, brands, logos, borders or watermark.

review.reason: The natural photograph has a recognizable stone mill, one intact wooden waterwheel, a single short waterfall ledge and a coherent stream path between grassy banks.

images.actual_source_analysis: A weathered stone watermill occupies the upper left with a pitched slate roof, one window and ivy. A large brown wooden waterwheel sits against its right wall above a clear stream. Water passes over a short stone ledge at center and flows toward the lower left foreground. Grass covers both banks and leafy trees frame the right background; there are no people or signs.
